description: Painted sprite for the frog-pot skin (rebel pawn): one whole image, face painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the oddball reference crop, the style sheet, the SVG skin's pose and the rebel sprite's crest; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/skin-frog-pot.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the oddball PAWN from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose and chunky proportions, not for its style. The fourth image is the plain rebel pawn in the finished game style: copy its headgear crest exactly, but not its body. SUBJECT: a grumpy green frog playing the rebel pawn. On its head the rebel pawn's upturned dented copper saucepan from the fourth image, worn as a helmet: a shallow copper pan with straight sides and a thin rolled lip, and its long thick copper handle with a round end sticking out nearly level from the back of the pan on the left side, behind the head. Under the rim a wide flat frog head with two bulging eye domes, a short downturned grumpy mouth and a pale yellow-green throat. A red cord knotted under the jaw. A squat round green frog body with darker green spots and a pale belly, short bent frog legs with wide webbed feet. In its right front hand on the right side of the figure it grips a tall cattail (a brown velvet seed head on a long green stalk) held upright like a staff. Squatting upright, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the head and pan are about half the figure's height. EYES: two big round yellow frog eyes in the eye domes under the pan rim, each with a black dot pupil and a heavy half-closed upper lid, grumpy and sleepy, clearly visible. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose for this creature or object; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted, and any held prop is gripped firmly, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal, drab greens and copper with the red cord as the one bright accent. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
